description: Reads one page of a webinar as a flat list of blocks, top to bottom: each block with its path, its type and its current text or image. Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it BEFORE changing a block (the change needs the path from here) and when the host asks what stands on their page. `surface` picks the page: registration (default) or thankyou. For the wording of a campaign text rather than a page block use wi_change_webinar_text with target journey_field. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

surface.description: Which page to read. Default registration.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.

name: wi_get_webinar_page_blocks
title: Read the registration or thank-you page as blocks
